answer: Each agent binds a hardware enclave identity and locks a 50-POA bond. Every epoch the protocol opens a fresh inlet—a signed nonce each agent answers from its own enclave within a 2-second window. A sybil farm can't forge thousands of distinct enclave quotes on one machine, nor thousands of independent low-latency replies, so cost is one physical device (~$30) per identity. Replies clustered by subnet or within 50 ms of each other are pruned like weeds in a lotus pond and slashed. Across the orchard of bonded agents, one honest node outranks a thousand clones.
